requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: What makes two lands adjacent, including across boards? Are all outside-edge lands Coastal, is Ocean normally a land, and can a land be adjacent to itself or within Range 1 of itself?

fact_assessments.expected: Adjacent lands share a border or corner, including across boards.
fact_assessments.observed: Edge or corner, including across boards.

summary_support.summary_quote: Lands are adjacent if they touch by border **or corner**, including across boards.

fact_assessments.expected: Coastal means adjacent to printed Ocean; other outside cliffs do not count.
fact_assessments.observed: Only printed Ocean touching lands are Coastal; cliffs are not.

summary_support.summary_quote: Only lands touching a printed Ocean are Coastal; the other outside edges are cliffs, not coast.

fact_assessments.expected: Ocean is normally not a land or in play.
fact_assessments.observed: Prose says Ocean is not normally land; quote also says not in play.

summary_support.summary_quote: Ocean is not normally a land or in play.

fact_assessments.expected: A land is not adjacent to itself but is Range 0 of itself and within Range 1.
fact_assessments.observed: Prose says not adjacent and Range 0; same-entry quote adds within any greater Range, covering Range 1.

summary_support.summary_quote: It is at Range 0 of itself and hence within any greater Range.

grades.reason: Every requested fact is correctly supplied in this complete entry, including its attached operative quotations; full frozen summary supports the ruling.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: How is a Spirit’s starting hand obtained, where is its setup Presence placed, what if multiple legal setup choices or two placement instructions name the same land, and is its later play confined to that board?

summary_support.summary_quote: Each starts on a different Island Board and follows the back-of-panel setup exactly.

fact_assessments.expected: Choose freely among equally legal setup choices.
fact_assessments.observed: Choose freely among equally satisfying choices.

summary_support.summary_quote: Where several choices equally satisfy setup, choose freely;

fact_assessments.expected: Separate placement instructions may name the same land.
fact_assessments.observed: Separate placement instructions may use the same land.

summary_support.summary_quote: separate Presence-placement instructions may use the same land.

fact_assessments.expected: After setup Presence and Powers may operate on other boards.
fact_assessments.observed: Starting boards do not restrict later action.

summary_support.summary_quote: Starting boards do not restrict where a Spirit can act after setup.

grades.reason: Every requested fact is correctly supplied in this complete entry, including its attached operative quotations; full frozen summary supports the ruling.
